newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Phillips to sign Venezuela venture Friday.
newsitem.headline: Phillips to sign Venezuela venture Friday.

text.p: Venezuela's state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) is expected to sign a refinery upgrade and crude oil supply deal with Phillips Petroleum Co on Friday, a PDVSA spokesman said on Tuesday.
The 50/50 joint venture plans to build a 60,000 barrel per day (bpd) coker at Phillips's Sweeny refinery which Phillips has said would be "highly financed".

The new coker would enable the 205,000 bpd refinery to run Venezuela's heavy Merey crude instead of its existing diet of light Middle Eastern oil, and PDVSA will supply 165,000 bpd under a long term contract as part of the joint-venture.
The coker would be ring-fenced and would not imply PDVSA taking a stake in the main body of the plant.
